video_title: Phoenix Suns Media Day 2026 Broadcast | Part 1

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker explains his return to wearing number 15.
quotes.quote: I feel back at home. This is not my first time wearing it. It is not a new number. It is a family number. I wore my first year of high school. When I got down to Mississippi, my dad had it retired, so I would not take it down from him. But all before that, too, elementary, grassroots, I was always in 15.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker explains why he is back to wearing number 15, saying it is a family number he wore throughout his youth.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker describes his natural competitive alter ego on the basketball court
quotes.quote: I actually don't know like how that happens, you know. But it just happened naturally. Like it's a natural alter ego, you know. Soon as I step in those lines, it's like I know it's business. I know if you're not on my team then, you know, I'm coming for you, you know. So it just happens alone. I don't control it. It's like the heart, you know.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says he has a natural alter ego when he steps on the court. He says as soon as he steps inside the lines, it is all business and if you are not on his team, he is coming for you.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker discusses his leadership role and team goals for the upcoming season.
quotes.quote: Just win as many games as possible. That is the state of my career that I am at and it is my job to lead the way, lead by example, lead by voice. And you know, I am not the only leader in the group. We have a lot of guys in here that are following coach, but I have been here the longest and it is my responsibility to make sure everyone is on the same page and so far so good with a good summer.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says his main goal is to win as many games as possible and emphasizes his responsibility as a leader to keep the team on the same page.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker discusses his approach to leadership and mentoring young players.
quotes.quote: My whole career I tried to be a sponge and learn from the older guys and I think I did a pretty good job of taking bits and pieces from the guys that I respected. So you know, I try to implement that in my everyday approach. We have guys that are the age that I was coming in, come on just turned 20, you know, Kobe is young 23, so these guys are young too. So you know, I just try to lead by example.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says he tries to lead by example and mentor the younger players on the team, just as he learned from veterans earlier in his career.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker expresses his commitment to the Phoenix Suns after signing a new contract.
quotes.quote: It was really important and obviously we all talked about it throughout the season. I have wanted to be here. I have always said that and it was something that was important on getting done. I do not think I ever thought about anything else, so I was not really concerned about it too much and we were able to get it done and it was pretty easy and efficient.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says he always wanted to be with the Phoenix Suns and that getting his new contract done was an easy and efficient process.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker discusses his role and the team's potential when healthy.
quotes.quote: Obviously we are a better basketball team when everybody is healthy and when everybody is able to be out there and I think our group we could do a lot of different things with the group that we have. But I know my role and I am trying to be the best version of myself, the best basketball player that I can be and whether I am asked to come off the bench and run the second unit, I am going to try to do that to the best of my ability.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says the Suns are a better team when healthy and he is focused on being the best version of himself, whether that means running the second unit or stepping into the starting lineup.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker credits his brother Justin Unidentified speaker for influencing his professional approach to basketball.
quotes.quote: Someone that I have seen since literally since I was born, you know, and being younger and seeing how he approached the game of baseball and you know, I thought I was going to do the same thing until I picked up the basketball and then I try to implement the same ways that he does in baseball and basketball. Just being, having a routine, being professional, no matter what happens in this league.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says his brother Justin Unidentified speaker has been a major influence on his professional approach to basketball, teaching him the importance of having a routine and being professional.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker highlights the competitive and supportive culture among the team's young players.
quotes.quote: I think I can speak for on this as well. Our only focus has been getting better. I told you he is going to give the diplomatic answer. No, that is it. Every every night when I come back there and I see in the gym and we push each other, we push each other every day in pickup and even when we are on opposite teams, we are still talking to each other, encouraging each other, holding each other accountable.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says the team's young players are focused on getting better and push each other every day, even when they are on opposite teams in pickup games.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker discusses his defensive role and competitive nature in practice.
quotes.quote: Honestly, everybody. Like I feel like I have been in situations where I have to guard everybody and I think me guarding them helps helps their game a lot and then vice versa. It is not nobody specific, especially because I do not like I do not talk much when I am on a court unless like somebody starts something with me.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says he enjoys guarding all his teammates in practice because it helps everyone improve their game.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker expresses gratitude for being drafted by the Phoenix Suns.
quotes.quote: I think everything works out and you know, being here at the Suns is, you know, I think that is the best situation that I could ask for. You know, I am super thankful for BG and you know, all the staff for, you know, just picking me and you know, that I can regret that.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says joining the Phoenix Suns is the best situation he could have asked for and he is thankful to the staff for drafting him.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Unidentified speaker explains his focus on daily improvement to stay consistent.
quotes.quote: Being able to live in that moment and don't look too much ahead like, oh, the week before training camp this and this. I looked at everyday like, what do I have to do today to get better today, not thinking about tomorrow, I'm not thinking about what happened yesterday.
quotes.social_post: Unidentified speaker says his focus is on daily improvement, rather than worrying about the past or the future, which helps him stay consistent in his work.
